# Billinox

> Billinox is an offline-first invoicing and billing app for freelancers, entrepreneurs, service providers, and small businesses. Create professional invoices, quotations, estimates, and receipts, manage customers, track payments, export PDFs, and work offline.

Billinox focuses on simple, professional business billing without requiring a constant internet connection. The official website provides product information, free invoice, receipt, and quotation tools, guides, support resources, and educational content about invoicing and small-business billing.

## Product

- [Billinox](https://billinox.com/): Official Billinox website and primary source for product information, features, pricing, and resources.
- [About Billinox](https://billinox.com/about/): Information about Billinox and its purpose.
- [Features](https://billinox.com/#features): Overview of Billinox features including invoicing, quotations, customer management, payment tracking, PDF export, reports, cloud backup, synchronization, and offline-first functionality.
- [Pricing](https://billinox.com/#pricing): Current Billinox plans, pricing, limits, and included features.
- [Help Center](https://billinox.com/help/): Help and support resources for using Billinox.
- [Contact](https://billinox.com/contact/): Official Billinox contact information.
